objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The current version number of the document, incremented on each revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 3 years) after which validity must be re-checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 10 years) for which an invalidated document is kept before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas for which the document is valid.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document appended to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version of the attachment, tracked independently but released with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the attachment, following the release process statuses of the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object added to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, created without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering the override (out of force) workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users that can be assigned authorizations collectively (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process consisting of steps (Creator, Review, Release) through which a document passes for approval.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (department, location) to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and may have process-specific document filing.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data (e.g. IT applications) that documents can be linked to.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user and role-specific view displaying documents and evaluation information relevant to the logged-in user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search function providing filtered result lists based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g. Status report: Documents & Instruction, Document monitoring, Status report: for acknowledgement).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is created in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions are made.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments have all authorizations revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_document_physically
evts.description: After the archive period expires, documents are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, notifying the creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or release participants confirm the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group for an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read and change rights are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system informs users of workflow status, pending tasks, or document events via email.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments that are released with it.
A document can be supplemented with additional information objects.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within it.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity must be checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to invalidate it.
A reactivation request references the invalidated document to be reactivated.
Documents can reference other documents via the References attribute.
One or more templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating documents.
A document has a distribution list defining user groups and persons for notification and acknowledgement.
Documents can be linked to and filed with business processes.
Documents can be linked to organizational units.
Documents can be linked to master data such as IT applications.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members receive document notifications.
A distribution list can contain individual persons for direct notification.
Users are assigned to user groups which grant them collective authorizations.
Users are assigned roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser) on specific documents controlling their permissions.
